customer_action: Reset AC by turning off MCB for 3 minutes. If error returns, book service.
technician_action: Check resistance of indoor air sensor (5kΩ-10kΩ at 25°C). Check PCB connector CN-TH1.

customer_action: Reset AC. Do not attempt to open unit.
technician_action: Measure pipe inlet sensor resistance. Verify sensor is properly clipped to copper pipe.

customer_action: Check if outdoor unit has power. Reset MCB once.
technician_action: Check continuity of communication wire (F1/F2 or L1/L2). Check terminal block tightness. Test PCB signal output.

description: Drain Pump Error or Float Switch Open
customer_action: Check if drain hose is kinked or submerged in water bucket.
technician_action: Test drain pump operation. Check float switch continuity. Clear drain line obstruction.

description: Communication Error Between Indoor and Outdoor Unit
customer_action: Ensure outdoor unit is powered. Reset system via MCB for 5 minutes.
technician_action: Check DC voltage between L1-L2 (should fluctuate 0-24V). Inspect wiring for cuts. Replace Indoor PCB first, then Outdoor PCB.

customer_action: Turn off AC immediately. Do not restart until serviced.
technician_action: Check fan blade for obstruction. Measure motor winding resistance. Test capacitor. Check PCB fan driver circuit.

customer_action: Ensure all indoor units are set to same mode (all Cool or all Heat). Mixed modes cause this error.
technician_action: Verify DIP switch settings on outdoor PCB match installation type. Reset system.

customer_action: Turn off AC. Book technician visit.
technician_action: Check blower wheel for debris. Measure BLDC motor feedback signal. Test indoor PCB fan driver.

description: Indoor Unit Drain Level High (Water Overflow Risk)
customer_action: Turn off AC immediately to prevent water damage. Check drain hose for blockage.
technician_action: Clear drain pipe clog. Test drain pump. Check float sensor position. Verify proper drain slope.

customer_action: Reset AC via MCB. If persists, schedule service.
technician_action: Check outlet pipe sensor connection and resistance. Ensure sensor is seated correctly on U-bend.

description: Outdoor IPM Fault (Inverter Power Module Overcurrent)
customer_action: Turn off AC at MCB. Do NOT attempt to restart. Call authorized service.
technician_action: Check compressor winding resistance. Test IPM module on outdoor PCB. Check refrigerant charge. Verify no mechanical lock in compressor.

customer_action: Reset system. If error returns, stop using unit.
technician_action: Check CT sensor connection on outdoor PCB. Measure current draw vs rated amps. Replace CT or PCB if faulty.

customer_action: Check home voltage stability. Use stabilizer if voltage <190V.
technician_action: Measure input AC voltage. Check rectifier bridge and smoothing capacitors on outdoor PCB. Verify compressor not drawing excessive current.

description: High Pressure Switch Open / Discharge Temp Too High
customer_action: Turn off AC. Ensure outdoor unit is not blocked. Clean condenser coil if accessible.
technician_action: Check condenser cleanliness. Verify fan operation. Measure discharge pressure. Check high-pressure switch continuity. Verify refrigerant charge.

customer_action: Turn off AC immediately. Do not retry. Book urgent service.
technician_action: Check compressor terminals U-V-W resistance. Test start/run capacitor. Check for mechanical seizure. Verify PCB output to compressor.

customer_action: Reset via MCB. If persistent, stop use.
technician_action: Check PFC reactor connections. Test PFC diode and MOSFET on outdoor PCB. Verify input voltage waveform.

customer_action: Turn off AC. Recent electrical work may have swapped phases.
technician_action: For 3-phase models: Swap any two input phase wires. For single-phase: Check compressor wiring sequence and capacitor.

customer_action: Clean outdoor unit condenser coil. Ensure adequate airflow clearance.
technician_action: Check condenser cleanliness. Verify refrigerant charge (low gas causes high discharge temp). Test discharge sensor accuracy.

customer_action: Reset system. Schedule service if error continues.
technician_action: Check outdoor pipe sensor connection and resistance. Verify sensor placement on condenser coil.

customer_action: Reset AC. Service needed if persistent.
technician_action: Test ambient sensor resistance. Check PCB connector. Replace sensor if out of spec.

customer_action: Reset system via MCB.
technician_action: Check discharge sensor clip on compressor top. Measure resistance. Replace if open/short.

customer_action: Reset AC. Book service if unresolved.
technician_action: Locate mid-condenser sensor. Test resistance and connection integrity.

customer_action: Reset system.
technician_action: Check suction pipe sensor attachment. Measure resistance. Verify no moisture ingress in connector.

customer_action: Power cycle system. Professional repair required.
technician_action: Re-flash outdoor PCB firmware if supported. Otherwise replace outdoor main PCB.

customer_action: Turn off AC for 30 minutes. Check for blocked outdoor unit airflow.
technician_action: Check condenser blockage. Measure running amps. Verify refrigerant charge. Check ambient temperature conditions.

customer_action: Ensure outdoor unit has proper ventilation. Turn off for 20 mins.
technician_action: Check heatsink thermal paste application. Verify fan speed. Clean heatsink fins. Check IPM mounting torque.

customer_action: Stop using AC. Authorized service only.
technician_action: Check compressor terminal connections. Test IPM output. Verify compressor not mechanically locked. May require compressor replacement.

customer_action: This appears during initial setup. Contact installer.
technician_action: Complete auto-addressing procedure. Verify DIP switches. Run commissioning test mode per service manual.
